project_metadata.description: A synthesized domain model for an e-commerce system, integrating multiple bounded contexts.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages customer profiles, their personal information, and associated wishlists.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: Represents a registered user of the system.

entities.name: Wishlist
entities.description: A collection of products a customer desires.

value_objects.name: WishlistItem
value_objects.description: Represents a single product entry in a customer's wishlist.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages product catalog, categories, and product specifications.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: An item available for sale in the catalog.

entities.name: Category
entities.description: A classification for organizing products hierarchically.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: Represents a monetary value with a specific currency.

value_objects.name: Image
value_objects.description: Represents an image with its URL and alternative text.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages the lifecycle of customer orders, from creation to delivery.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A customer's request to purchase products.

entities.name: OrderItem
entities.description: A specific product and quantity within an order.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages product stock levels across warehouses and prevents overselling.

entities.name: StockLevel
entities.description: Represents the quantity of a product available in a specific warehouse.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles payment processing, transactions, and refunds for orders.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: A record of a financial transaction for an order.

entities.name: Refund
entities.description: A record of money returned to a customer for a payment.

value_objects.name: PaymentMethodInfo
value_objects.description: Represents masked details of a payment method used for a transaction.
